bullets.text: AI Model Competition Heats Up - **DeepSeek**'s V4 model aims to rival **OpenAI** and others.
Motorola Razr Fold Pricing Revealed - UK pre-orders start at £1,800, raising questions about US pricing.
Meta Introduces Live Chats - New feature enhances engagement during major cultural events on **Threads**.
Apple TV's Crime Thriller Returns - **Criminal Record** season 2 debuts with a gripping London plot.
Hidden Apple Watch Feature - **Time in Daylight** tracks sunlight exposure automatically for health benefits.
Pioneering CarPlay Feature - **Pioneer** launches aftermarket **Dolby Atmos** support for existing vehicles.
OpenAI Enhances Codex - New **Chronicle** feature improves context awareness for coding tasks.
AI-Powered Doomscrolling - **Noscroll** offers a bot to filter important news from social media.
Meta Job Cuts Announced - **Meta** plans to lay off 10% of its workforce, affecting 8,000 employees.
Bluesky Enhances Photo Quality - New update allows higher resolution photo uploads on the platform.
